LESSON: RESPONDING TO

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Responding to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Responding to
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: when asked instructions a) respond confidently to questions and to pronunciation and accuracy with to do something?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. ask questions to seek clarity on  Learners play language games involving instructions responding to instructions and
2. demonstrate willingness to answer answering questions(songs, games questions and follow instructions following a particular pattern) in pairs and groups

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Responding to

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Responding to

Teach
• Focus skill: ask questions to seek clarity on  Learners play language games involving instructions responding to instructions and.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Responding to.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Responding to
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. when asked instructions a) respond confidently to questions and to pronunciation and accuracy with to do something?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
